'''Cov''' was the squad leader of [[Yayax Squad]]. He was in one of the squads trained by [[Rav Bralor]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. He wore a gray-and-brown dazzle-pattern [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|Katarn armor]] like the rest of his squad. He was also seen with brown coloring on his armor.

During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] he assisted [[Omega Squad]] with [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Trooper]] Lieutenant [[Aven (clone trooper)|Aven]] in defending the [[HoloNet News and Entertainment|HNE]] Headquarters building from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attack. He and the rest of Yayax Squad deserted and joined [[Kal Skirata]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], where they were responsible for farming and infrastructure duties at the Kyrimorut compound, alongside [[Levet]]. He was taken to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by [[Nyreen Vollen|Nyreen "Ny" Vollen]]. At one point, Cov fell in love with [[Ruusaan Skirata]] and engaged in a romantic relationship.
